false_oracle_rate.rule: wrong-expectation verdicts / decided candidate failures (planted-defect catches count as real; U excluded)

minimized_standalone.note: every caught defect is caught by one standalone scenario file

phase4_adoption_decision.rule: separated is adopted only if the false-oracle rate drops without losing valid-bug yield
phase4_adoption_decision.reasoning: false-oracle rates tied at 0 percent after human review; separated caught 10 planted defects and 2 real clean-revision bugs versus 11 and 3 for control, so the yield condition is not met. The separated design uniquely rediscovered documented-contract violations via its invariant catalog and remains the first candidate to revisit if false oracles appear at scale.
